verdict.rationale: For a processor, the 'API' is its software SDK, and AMD documents several public programmatic interfaces for driving the NPU and iGPU. These include ONNX Runtime with the Vitis AI EP via Python/C++ APIs, a Lemonade server interface usable from any language, high-level Python LLM APIs, CVML C++ library APIs, and programmatic device detection, plus an llms.txt index. Missing for 10: no machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes all 404), the APIs are spread across layered toolkits (ONNX Runtime, Lemonade, CVML) rather than one unified API, and there is no independent hands-on confirmation of the Ryzen AI SDK APIs.
